_comment: ADR-0051 (profiling-stage free chat, #2027). The Zod shapes live in packages/ai-contracts/src/free-chat.ts and the Pydantic mirror in apps/ai-service/app/contracts.py; BOTH suites assert against this file, so a field added on one side only turns the other side red.
